The weather was sunny that day. Owen borrowed a book about music from the museum. Anna is interested in dancing. Also, we went downtown to do some shopping.
Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Owen hopes to visit Rome one day. The city square is one of the best places in the city. In fact, the café sits on a busy intersection.
There are always many people at the pedestrian street. Both of them like noodles and milk. Owen is reading a book about music. For example, the stadium was full of cheering fans.
Owen is going to travel to Rome in August. Owen learned a lot about music. Owen and Anna had great fun there.
